BrochureContent.Content:
**EMAIL ENQUIRIES ONLY / NO PHONE CALLS**

Doran Estates are delighted to present No. 69 Milltown Manor to the rental market. This exceptional four-bedroom detached home extends to over 130 sq.m and offers spacious, energy-efficient accommodation finished to a high standard throughout. Boasting an impressive A-rated BER, this modern home combines contemporary design, comfort and practicality in one of Ashbourne's most sought-after residential developments.
Milltown Manor is a thoughtfully planned, low-density community featuring attractive open green spaces and beautifully landscaped surroundings. Designed to blend timeless architectural style with modern living, the development offers a welcoming environment with excellent amenities close at hand.
The accommodation is bright, spacious and well laid out. Upon entering, a welcoming entrance hall leads to a generous front-facing living room, creating an ideal space for relaxation and entertaining. A guest WC is conveniently located off the hallway, while the heart of the home is the stylish open-plan kitchen and dining area. Finished with contemporary fittings and ample storage, the kitchen provides excellent functionality for everyday living. Double doors open directly onto a private rear garden, allowing for an abundance of natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor living. A separate utility room is located just off the kitchen, while additional storage is available beneath the staircase.
Upstairs, the first floor comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms, offering flexible accommodation to suit a variety of living arrangements. The principal bedroom benefits from a private en-suite bathroom. A spacious family bathroom, complete with both a bath and separate shower enclosure, serves the remaining bedrooms. Two additional storage cupboards on this level further enhance the practicality of the property.
Milltown Manor enjoys an enviable location within the thriving town of Ashbourne. Residents benefit from an excellent selection of amenities including supermarkets, independent retailers, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities. Well-known retailers in the area include Dunnes Stores, Tesco, Lidl, Aldi, SuperValu, Boots and Specsavers. Ashbourne also offers a wide range of educational facilities, healthcare services, sports clubs and recreational amenities, including Ashbourne Golf Club, Ashbourne Rugby Club, Donaghmore Ashbourne GAA Club, tennis and cricket clubs, as well as a multiscreen cinema.
For commuters, the location is exceptionally convenient. The property is just minutes from the M2 motorway, providing easy access to the M50, Dublin Airport and Dublin City Centre. Regular Bus Éireann services also connect Ashbourne with Dublin City Centre, Blanchardstown, Dublin Airport and Navan.
This superb A-rated home offers a rare opportunity to rent a modern, spacious and energy-efficient property in a highly desirable and well-connected location.
Key Features:
• A-rated energy-efficient home
• Four spacious bedrooms
• Principal bedroom with en-suite
• Contemporary kitchen with dining area
• Separate utility room
• Guest WC
• Family bathroom with bath and separate shower
• Private rear garden
• Excellent storage throughout
• Over 130 sq.m of well-designed accommodation
• Located within a prestigious residential development
• Minutes from Ashbourne town centre and M2 motorway
• Excellent transport links to Dublin City Centre and Dublin Airport

Viewing highly recommend !
